verdictReason: The specification is accurate and complete, and the local implementation gates are strong, but production feasibility cannot be approved while the real R2D2/Vertex, Core identity/vault, Sonic and cluster ingress/egress dependencies remain unavailable and their required staging evidence is absent.

issues.description: R2D2/Vertex production compatibility and representative semantic quality are unverified (ED-01/SPK-01).
issues.suggestion: Assign the gateway owner and run the real staging compile/quality corpus with approved credentials and model configuration.

issues.description: Trusted identity, real vault authorization and CSRF posture are not delivered or linked (ED-02).
issues.suggestion: Link and complete the Core delivery, then run the credentialed authorization and secret-canary pilot.

issues.description: Production Sonic and cluster ingress/egress/sandbox behavior remain unverified (ED-03 through ED-06 and related spikes).
issues.suggestion: Provision the staging stack and record real storage, Range, SSE, media, sandbox, DNS/egress and seek evidence.

nextAction: Halt the strict pipeline before plan/completion. Assign external owners and resume from critique after the integrated staging evidence exists.
